AnalysisInputs.description:
What the analysis started from: the entered terminus and the material.

The terminus is the event's, with the run's overrides: the fixed terminus
in Simple mode, the centre of the search otherwise.

altitude_m.description: Terminus altitude. Height above the WGS84 ellipsoid, metres.

azimuth_deg.description: Direction of travel, degrees clockwise from true north (not the radiant direction, which differs by 180 degrees).

declination_deg.description: Trajectory angle below horizontal, degrees (90 = vertical).

mass_lost_pct.description: Share of the mass lost in bright flight, percent.

AnalysisInputs.title: AnalysisInputs

mass_class.description: Its decadal mass class, e.g. '10 g-100 g'.

BlipResult.description: One radar blip: what was observed, and the fragment that explains it.

label.description: Display name: radar, volume start HHMM, elevation (e.g. 'KGRR_0551_1.50').

sweep_number.description: Sweep number in its volume scan.

volume_scan_start_utc.description: Start of the sweep's volume scan (UTC).

volume_file_start_utc.description: Start of the radar file holding the sweep (UTC).

altitude_m.description: Observed altitude. Height above the WGS84 ellipsoid, metres.

reflectivity_dbz.description: The blip's strongest pixel reflectivity, dBZ.

z_min_dbz.description: Mean detection floor of the blip's pixels, dBZ (dBZ0 + 20 log10 of the range in km).

delta_z_db.description: Largest margin of a pixel above its detection floor, dB.

time_after_terminus_s.description: Observed time minus terminus time, s (negative before the terminus).

status_detail.description: Why the blip was not solved.

mass_kg.description: Fitted fragment mass, kg (0 when not solved).

fragment_count.description: Fragments of that mass the blip's reflectivity implies (dimensionless). Absent for Doppler sweeps and TDWR.

fall_time_s.description: Flight time from the terminus to the ground, s.

time_residual_s.description: Model arrival at the blip's altitude minus observed, s.

distance_residual_m.description: Horizontal miss at the blip's altitude, metres.

crossing_utm_easting_m.description: Where the fitted mass crossed the blip's altitude: UTM easting, m.

landing_lat.description: Canonical landing site (radar-corrected; as calculated in Centerline Alignment, where an unsolved blip has none). Latitude, degrees north (WGS84).

radar_corrected_landing_lat.description: Landing flown on from the blip's observed position. Latitude, degrees north (WGS84).

BlipResult.title: BlipResult

Confidence.description: Informational confidence in the result (never gates a calculation).

centerline_ssr_m2.description: Squared cross-track misses of the landings, m^2.

spatial_consistency_factor.description: From the landings' scatter about the centreline.

Confidence.title: Confidence

FittedTerminus.description: The fitted terminus: where dark flight begins.

utm_northern.description: True for the northern-hemisphere UTM zone.

utm_easting_m.description: UTM easting of the terminus, metres.

utm_northing_m.description: UTM northing of the terminus, metres.

altitude_m.description: Fitted altitude. Height above the WGS84 ellipsoid, metres.

azimuth_deg.description: Direction of travel, degrees clockwise from true north (not the radiant direction, which differs by 180 degrees).

declination_deg.description: Trajectory angle below horizontal, degrees (90 = vertical).

density_kg_m3.description: Bulk density used for the masses, kg/m^3 (fitted in Full Parameter Refinement).

at_search_edge.description: Searched values that ended within 2% of their range's edge.

mean_blip_offset_east_m.description: Mean eastward offset of the blips from where the fitted path crossed their altitudes, metres.

offset_lat.description: The terminus moved by the mean offset. Latitude, degrees north (WGS84).

offset_lon.description: The terminus moved by the mean offset. Longitude, degrees east (WGS84).

FittedTerminus.title: FittedTerminus

Forensics.description: What the solved masses add up to.

radar_total_mass_kg.description: Sum of mass times fragment count over valid blips, kg.

findable_mass_kg.description: As radar_total_mass_kg, for fragments of 1 g and more, kg.

transition_mass_kg.description: Rayleigh/Mie transition mass rho * lambda^3 / (6 pi^2) at S band, kg.

empirical_transition_mass_kg.description: Where the two regime lines cross, kg.

empirical_density_kg_m3.description: The density that crossing implies, kg/m^3.

empirical_transition_in_sample.description: True when the crossing lies between the regimes' observed masses.

largest_fragment_statistical_kg.description: Mass at which the power law reaches one fragment, kg (0 when the fit is poor).

largest_fragment_radar_budget_kg.description: Largest fragment for which the power law holds the radar total, kg.

largest_fragment_global_budget_kg.description: Largest fragment for which the power law holds the global total, kg.

Forensics.title: Forensics

MassClassErrors.description: The error table's row for one decadal mass class (1.1; Fenrir D5a draft).

mass_class.description: The decadal mass class, e.g. '10 g-100 g'.

along_track_sigma_m.description: Median 1-sigma landing error along the direction of travel, m.

cross_track_sigma_m.description: Median 1-sigma landing error across the direction of travel, m.

wind_share.description: The share of the class's landing variance from the wind (1.2): the spread between the wind ensemble's members over the total, median of its blips.

MassClassErrors.title: MassClassErrors

shift_m.description: The re-fitted terminus's horizontal distance from the main fit's, m.

altitude_shift_m.description: The re-fitted terminus height minus the main fit's, m.

OutputFiles.description: The run's output files, as paths relative to the run folder.

contours_geojson.description: Concentration contours (when the map layers were on).

uncertainty_kmz.description: The probability areas for Google Earth (1.1).

OutputFiles.title: OutputFiles

name.description: UTM easting (m), UTM northing (m), terminus height above sea level (m), azimuth (deg), declination (deg), density (kg/m^3) or speed (m/s).

value.description: The fitted value, in the name's unit.

sigma.description: Its 1-sigma uncertainty, in the name's unit.

capped_at_search_range.description: True when the blips do not constrain it and sigma is the search half-range.

PowerLawFit.description: Least-squares fit of log10 fragment count on log10 mass in grams.

slope_b.description: Slope b of N = k * m^b (m in grams).

r2_adjusted.description: R^2 adjusted for the fit's degrees of freedom.

PowerLawFit.title: PowerLawFit

ProbabilityEllipse.description: An area holding a probability of a blip's fragment landing (1.1).

major_azimuth_deg.description: The major axis's direction, degrees clockwise from true north.

ProbabilityEllipse.title: ProbabilityEllipse

ProbabilityRegion.description: A highest-density region holding a probability, for a mass class or the fall (1.1).

mass_class.description: The decadal mass class, or 'fall' for all blips.

outlines.description: Its outlines, each a list of [latitude, longitude] points, degrees (plain lists, not tuples, so generated clients agree on the type).

ProbabilityRegion.title: ProbabilityRegion

RadarSweep.description: One sweep of the radar file.

sweep_id.description: The blip identifier this sweep gives, e.g. 'KGRR_3_0'.

sweep_number.description: Sweep number in its volume scan.

volume_scan_start_utc.description: Start of the sweep's volume scan (UTC).

selected.description: True when the sweep was used in this run.

RadarSweep.title: RadarSweep

RegimeFit.description: A log10 count on log10 mass (grams) line for one scattering regime.
RegimeFit.title: RegimeFit

fenrir_version.description: Version of Fenrir that wrote the file.

analysis_mode.description: Fit mode: 'simple' (the entered terminus), 'algebraic_surrogate', 'centerline_alignment', or 'full_parameter_refinement' (all parameters fitted at once).

wind_data_flagged.description: Why the wind data were flagged, when the analyst accepted flagged data.

anchor_blip_index.description: Centerline Alignment's anchor blip, counted among the blips with a mass.

ReverseDiagnostic.description:
A blip's offset carried back to the terminus.

The fitted mass is flown from the terminus to the blip's altitude; the
blip's horizontal offset from that crossing, moved to the terminus,
shows where the terminus would sit to match this blip alone.

altitude_m.description: Height above the WGS84 ellipsoid, metres.

distance_to_terminus_m.description: Horizontal distance from the fitted terminus, metres.

time_s.description: Flight time from the terminus to the blip's altitude, s.

ReverseDiagnostic.title: ReverseDiagnostic

ReverseOffsets.description: Spread of the solved blips' reverse-diagnostic distances to the terminus.
ReverseOffsets.title: ReverseOffsets

parameters.description: Order of the values in every list below: UTM easting (m), UTM northing (m), altitude (m), azimuth (deg), declination (deg), density (kg/m^3), speed (m/s).

scout_samples.description: The Latin-hypercube scout samples, one list per sample, in parameters order.

scout_costs.description: Each scout sample's spline cost, m^2 (summed squared misses).

sobol_first_order.description: First-order Sobol indices of the cost.

sobol_total.description: Total-order Sobol indices of the cost.

sobol_first_order_conf.description: 95% confidence half-widths of sobol_first_order. From an unseeded bootstrap, so they differ from run to run.

cost.description: The search's cost (1.1): 'legacy' (the spline cost), 'direct' (each blip's nearest mass solved, optionally with blip times) or 'weighted' (in units of each blip's uncertainty). Absent: legacy.

blips_behind_terminus.description: Blips lying behind the fitted terminus's direction of travel, horizontally (1.1): reported, not penalized, by the direct and weighted costs.

SearchGrid.description: Where to search, cell by cell (1.1): the cells of the fall's 90 % region.
SearchGrid.title: SearchGrid

probability.description: The cell's share of the fall's landings, 0-1.

centre.description: Centre of the search, in the value's unit.

half_width.description: Searched ± this much, in the value's unit (0 when fixed).

fixed.description: True when the value was held fixed.

SearchRanges.description: How each value was searched (modes other than Simple).

lat.description: North-south position: centre and half-width as UTM northing, m.

lon.description: East-west position: centre and half-width as UTM easting, m.

density.description: Bulk density, kg/m^3 (centre: mid-range; half-width: half the range).

SearchRanges.title: SearchRanges

Uncertainty.description: Level 1 probability areas, search grid and error tables (1.1; Fenrir D19, D5a).

area_scale.description: The calibration factor applied to the areas' linear size (1: none).

correlations.description: The parameters' correlation matrix, in ``parameters`` order.

wind.description: The wind ensemble (1.2); absent when the wind was not sampled.

Uncertainty.title: Uncertainty

UncertaintyFitQuality.description: How well the fit explains the blips (1.1).

residual_m.description: RMS residual per blip of the fit's cost (with blip times), m-equivalent.

spatial_residual_m.description: RMS horizontal miss of the blips, m.

UncertaintyFitQuality.title: UncertaintyFitQuality

WindLevel.description: The wind at one altitude above the fitted terminus.

altitude_m.description: Height above the WGS84 ellipsoid, metres.

east_mps.description: Eastward wind component (toward the east), m/s.

north_mps.description: Northward wind component (toward the north), m/s.

direction_from_deg.description: Direction the wind blows from, degrees clockwise from true north.

WindLevel.title: WindLevel

WindUncertainty.description: How the wind entered the uncertainty (1.2; Fenrir D20).

source.description: The wind samples' source, e.g. 'ERA5 ensemble'.

refit.description: True when the fit was re-run for each member.

WindUncertainty.title: WindUncertainty

event_id.description: The fall's identifier, as in its event.json.

forensics.description: Absent when no blip was solved.

wind_profile.description: The wind above the fitted terminus, from the ground up, every 250 m.

radar_detection_span_s.description: Time from the first to the last sweep start in the radar file, s.

uncertainty.description: Level 1 probability areas (1.1); absent when not computed.
